title: Attuning Our Lives to the Love of God | Brother Chidananda

# Attuning Our Lives to the Love of God

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Loving blessings. Brother Chidananda shares beautiful guidance on how to attune our lives to the infinite, healing love of God. God is not a cold judge; He is the most loving, compassionate Parent who is always waiting for us to turn our attention backward to Him.

### The All-Enveloping Presence

No matter what trials we face in this life, God's love is closer than our very breath. By practicing daily meditation and devotional chanting, we dissolve the dry intellectual barriers of the mind and let the sweet nectar of His presence overflow in our hearts.

### Overcoming Loneliness with Divine Friendship

The soul is always seeking its native partner. When you experience moments of loneliness, take it as a divine call from the Mother to sit in silence and drink His divine peace.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Morning Devotion:** Establish your meditation routine before checking any phones or digital devices.
* **Loving Whispers:** Keep a silent, continuous repeat of *"Jai Guru"* or *"I love Thee, Lord"* in the background of your mind.
* **See Him in All:** Seek to serve other people with the attitude that you are serving the Divine within them.
* **Night Communion:** Spend a few quiet moments before sleep expressing gratitude for His constant protection.

May the peace of the Great Ones be yours. Jai Guru!
